raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

python-dateutil 3.0.0 (released 2026-10-21) is getting installed by the docker deps step and frozen into constraints.txt. botocore, pulled in later by runai-model-streamer[s3], requires python-dateutil<3.0.0, so the framework dev-tools install can no longer resolve (pip backtracks through every boto3 release and fails with resolution-too-deep). This causes docker/Dockerfile and docker/Dockerfile.cu134 to fail to build (maybe others too).

Error message from last night's build: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39699311622/job/119564418214
```
#59 12.35          Because botocore>=1.43.116 depends on python-dateutil>=2.1,<3.0.0 and boto3==1.43.116 depends on botocore>=1.43.116, we can conclude that boto3==1.43.116 depends on python-dateutil>=2.1,<3.0.0.
#59 12.35          And because we know from (3) that all of:
#59 12.35              boto3<=1.43.115
#59 12.35              boto3>=1.43.117
#59 12.35           and python-dateutil>=3.0.0 are incompatible, we can conclude that all versions of boto3 and python-dateutil>=3.0.0 are incompatible.
#59 12.35          And because runai-model-streamer-s3>=0.17.0 depends on boto3 and runai-model-streamer[s3]>=0.17.0 depends on runai-model-streamer-s3==0.17.0, we can conclude that python-dateutil>=3.0.0 and runai-model-streamer[s3]>=0.17.0 are incompatible.
#59 12.35          And because pandas==3.0.6 depends on python-dateutil==3.0.0 and you require pandas==3.0.6, we can conclude that your requirements, all of:
#59 12.35              runai-model-streamer<0.15.7
#59 12.35              runai-model-streamer>0.16.1
#59 12.35          , runai-model-streamer[s3]>=0.15.7 are incompatible.
#59 12.35          And because you require runai-model-streamer[s3]>=0.15.7 and runai-model-streamer==0.17.0, we can conclude that your requirements are unsatisfiable.
#59 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c uv pip install -c /sgl-workspace/constraints.txt     datamodel_code_generator     pre-commit     pytest     black     isort     icdiff     wheel     scikit-build-core     py-spy     cubloaty     google-cloud-storage     pandas     matplotlib     tabulate     termplotlib     \"runai-model-streamer[s3,gcs,azure]>=0.15.7\"" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
```

## Modifications

Pin to <3.0.0 to fix dependencies

## Accuracy Tests

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
